title: 第7章 让你写小作文又没答应做你男朋友
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 大概过了五分钟。这五分钟里，叶凛甚至还有闲心去厨房给自已倒了杯水，顺便把盘子里夏晚晴剩下的三个饺子给扫荡了。“来了来了！”夏晚晴指着手机屏幕，比当事人还激动，脑袋恨不得钻进屏幕里去。屏幕上，一段长达几百字的小作文弹了出来。排版工整，还贴心地加了几个流泪的表情。【秦菲菲：叶凛，其实从第一次见到你，我就觉得你是个很特别的男生。】【你虽然没钱，也不爱说话，但你那双眼睛总是让我忍不住想靠近……】【还记得大一军训那天在操场吗？你给我递的那瓶水，是我喝过最甜的水……】【虽然我们要分开了，但我永远不会忘记那个晚上，不会忘记你……】【叶凛，做我男朋友好吗？】【哪怕只有一秒，我想听你亲口说爱我。】洋洋洒洒，情真意切。不去写小说简直是文学界的损失。如果不看她现在正躺在王家大少怀里等着去做头发的事实，这简直就是一篇满分的深情告白。“呕——”夏晚晴做了一个极其夸张的干呕动作：“太恶心了，这女的怎么能一边劈腿一边写出这种东西的？”“而且那瓶水明明是你买给我喝的，被她抢走了还没给钱吧？”叶凛看得津津有味，甚至还在心里给这段话批改了一下语法错误。“不懂了吧，这就是专业。”“男人也好，女人也罢，当舔狗的下场只有被踹和接盘。”“真搞不懂什么样的蠢货才会被这种没脑子的女人耍得团团转。”手机那头。市中心某高档公寓内。秦菲菲发完这段话，握着手机，脸上的表情管理非常到位。她几乎能想象到叶凛此刻感动的样子。那个穷小子一定会秒回“我同意”，然后哭着发一大段挽留的话。甚至可能现在已经跪在地上痛哭流涕了。不管怎么样，这个过场走完，自已就能心安理得地去当王少奶奶了。毕竟是“和平分手”。屏幕顶端显示“对方正在输入……”。来了。秦菲菲轻哼一声，端起高脚杯抿了一口红酒，等待着那个卑微的“同意”。那种掌控一切的快感让她浑身毛孔都舒张开了。“叮咚！”消息来了。只有简简单单的三个字。【叶凛：我拒绝。】秦菲菲的手一抖，高脚杯差点没拿稳。她刚刚发出去一句问候叶凛家人的话。【您还不是对方的好友。】那个红色的感叹号，像是一个响亮的耳光，狠狠地扇在了秦菲菲那张精致的脸上。“噗——！！！”刚喝进嘴里的红酒，这次是一滴不剩，全喷在了手机屏幕上。秦菲菲整个人僵在原地，眼珠子差点瞪出眼眶，那种表情就像是吞了一只死苍蝇。拒绝？他拒绝了？！让自已写了几百字的表白小作文，回顾了那么多的细节，把自尊都放下了……结果他拒绝了？！而且还把自已拉黑了？！这算什么？这是把自已当猴耍吗？！“啊啊啊啊啊！！！”一声尖锐的咆哮穿透了高档公寓的隔音玻璃，惊起了窗外几只路过的麻雀。连正在浴室洗澡的王大少都被吓得一激灵，差点滑倒。“叶凛！我要杀了你！！！”……出租屋内。“卧槽？！”夏晚晴眼珠子都要瞪出来了，嘴巴张得老大，那表情比看见外星人还惊悚。她看着屏幕上已经消失在叶凛好友列表里的【170,42D，爱穿黑丝】又看了看叶凛那张云淡风轻的脸，感觉自已的CPU也烧了。“你……你这是什么操作？不是复合吗？”“她要我就给，那我不成舔狗了吗？”叶凛耸了耸肩，把手机往沙发上一扔。“她表白是她的权利，我拒绝是我的自由。”“现在流程走完了。”“她表白了，被我拒了，然后被我拉黑了。”“这才是故事的结局。”叶凛站起身，走到窗边。“虽然有些可惜那几百块的转账红包以后没了，不过没必要为了不属于自已的东西懊悔。”“毕竟……我已经拥有过她最好的时候了，不管是钱，还是人。”夏晚晴愣了足足三秒。然后——“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！”她笑得整个人从沙发上滑了下去，捂着肚子在地上打滚，眼泪都飙出来了。“让人家表白，然后拒绝拉黑！这也就是隔着网线。”“要是面对面，她估计能把你生吞活剥了！”“是她先找不痛快的。”“其实如果她不是抱着把我当男朋友然后试图绿我的话，我还真挺舍不得这段关系的。”“她不发跟猪的合照给我，骂我两句我也忍了。”“反正我还真挺渣的。”叶凛拉开那条有些发黄的窗帘。窗外，夜色深沉。远处市中心的方向，那座巨大的、散发着幽幽光芒的神像，即便是在黑夜中也显得格外刺眼。那是赫菲斯托斯的神像。虽然隔着很远，但叶凛依然能感觉到一股若有若无的压迫感，那种力量像是一把悬在头顶的达摩克利斯之剑。那个小心眼的铁匠，估计还在满世界找自已吧。“行了，别笑了，再笑岔气了我可没钱送你去医院。”叶凛转过身，看着还在地上傻乐的夏晚晴，踢了踢她的小腿。“吃饱了吗？”夏晚晴擦了擦眼角的泪花，从地上爬起来拍拍屁股：“饱了饱了，这瓜吃得太撑了，比饺子还顶。”“吃饱了就干活。”叶凛从口袋里掏出那半瓶【晨曦玫瑰精油】，放在茶几上。玻璃瓶里面的液体粘稠如蜜，隐约还能看到细碎的金光在流转。一股奇异的玫瑰花香瞬间弥漫在狭窄的出租屋里。仅仅是闻了一口，夏晚晴就感觉浑身的疲惫都消散了不少。“这是啥？”夏晚晴好奇地凑过来，伸手想拿。“别动。”叶凛拍开她的爪子。“这可是好东西，能让你变强的好东西。”既然要把这丫头培养成打手……哦不，伙伴。那就得从现在开始投资。毕竟，接下来的日子，可不太平。神话复苏初期，普通人就是蝼蚁。他叶凛虽然有了系统，但也需要一个信得过的帮手。主要是，他不想给神当狗。这瓶精油是阿芙洛狄忒给的，虽然只剩半瓶，但那是神用的东西。应该……好用吧？“所以你要干吗？”夏晚晴疑惑的问道。叶凛扫了眼她平平无奇的胸口：“把衣服脱了。”
content_en: About five minutes passed.In these five minutes, Ye Lin even had the time to go to the kitchen and pour herself a glass of water, and by the way, she wiped away the three dumplings left by Xia Wanqing on the plate."It's coming, it's coming!" Xia Wanqing pointed at the screen of her mobile phone, even more excited than the person involved, and her head wanted to get into the screen.On the screen, a short composition of several hundred words popped up.The layout is neat, and a few tearful expressions are thoughtfully added.[Qin Feifei: Ye Lin, actually from the first time I met you, I felt that you were a very special boy.】【Although you have no money and don't like to talk, your eyes always make me want to get closer...】【Do you still remember the day of military training in freshman year on the playground?The bottle of water you handed me was the sweetest water I have ever drunk...] [Although we are about to separate, I will never forget that night, and I will never forget you...] [Ye Lin, will you be my boyfriend?】【Even if it’s just for a second, I want to hear you say you love me.】Easy and sincere.It would be a loss to the literary world not to write novels.If you don't look at the fact that she is currently lying in the arms of the eldest son of the Wang family, waiting to have her hair done, this is simply a perfect and affectionate confession."Ugh -" Xia Wanqing made an extremely exaggerated retching motion: "It's so disgusting. How could this woman write such a thing while cheating?" "And you obviously bought the bottle of water for me to drink, but she took it away and you didn't give me the money, right?" Ye Lin read it with gusto, and even mentally corrected the grammatical errors in this paragraph."You don't understand, this is professionalism." "Whether it's a man or a woman, the only result of being a dog licker is to be kicked and taken over." "I really don't understand what kind of idiot would be played around by such a brainless woman." On the other end of the phone.In a high-end apartment in the city center.After Qin Feifei sent this message, she held her mobile phone and managed the expression on her face very well.She could almost imagine how moved Ye Lin was at this moment.That poor boy will definitely reply "I agree" in seconds, and then cry and send a long message to plead with him.You may even be on your knees crying right now.No matter what, after this scene is over, I can go back to being Young Mistress Wang with peace of mind.It was a "peaceful breakup" after all."The other party is typing..." is displayed at the top of the screen.Coming.Qin Feifei snorted softly, picked up the goblet and took a sip of red wine, waiting for the humble "agree".The pleasure of being in control of everything made the pores all over her body relax."Ding dong!" came the message.Just three simple words.[Ye Lin: I refuse.] Qin Feifei's hand shook and she almost lost her hold on the goblet.She just sent a greeting to Ye Lin's family.[You are not the other party’s friend yet.】That red exclamation mark was like a loud slap, slapping Qin Feifei's delicate face hard."Pfft!" This time, not a drop of the red wine he just drank was left on the phone screen.Qin Feifei froze in place, her eyes almost popped out of her sockets, her expression was like swallowing a dead fly.reject?He refused?!He asked himself to write a confession essay of several hundred words, reviewed so many details, and put down his self-esteem... but he refused?!And he also blocked himself?!What is this?Are you treating yourself like a monkey?!"Ahhhhhh!!!" A sharp roar penetrated the soundproof glass of the high-end apartment, startling a few passing sparrows outside the window.Even Mr. Wang, who was taking a shower in the bathroom, was so frightened that he almost slipped."Ye Lin! I'm going to kill you!!!"...In the rental house."What the fuck?!" Xia Wanqing's eyes almost popped out, her mouth opened wide, and her expression was more horrifying than seeing an alien.She looked at [170,42D, who loves to wear black stockings] who had disappeared from Ye Lin's friend list on the screen, and then looked at Ye Lin's calm face, feeling that her CPU was also burning."You...what are you doing? Isn't it getting back together?" "I'll give it to her if she wants it, so am I no longer a licker?" Ye Lin shrugged and threw the phone on the sofa."It's her right to confess, and my freedom to refuse." "Now the process is over." "She confessed, but I rejected her, and then I blocked her." "This is the end of the story." Ye Lin stood up and walked to the window."Although it's a pity that the transfer red envelope of several hundred yuan is gone, there is no need to regret for something that does not belong to you." "After all... I have had the best time for her, whether it is money or people." Xia Wanqing was stunned for three seconds.Then - "Hahahahahaha!" She laughed so hard that she slid off the sofa, rolling on the ground holding her stomach, tears bursting out of her eyes."Let people confess their feelings, and then refuse to block them! This is just across the network cable." "If we were face to face, she would probably eat you alive!" "She was the one who found it unpleasant in the first place." "Actually, if she didn't hold me as her boyfriendMy friend then tried to flatter me, but I really couldn’t bear to leave this relationship.”“She didn’t send me a photo with the pig, and I couldn’t bear to scold me.”“Anyway, I’m really a scumbag.”Ye Lin opened the yellowed curtain.Outside the window, the night is dark.In the distance in the direction of the city center, the huge statue with a faint light looked particularly dazzling even in the dark night.That's the statue of Hephaestus.Although he was far away, Ye Lin could still feel a vague sense of oppression. The power was like a sword of Damocles hanging above his head.That petty blacksmith is probably still looking for him all over the world."Okay, stop laughing. If you stop laughing, I won't have the money to take you to the hospital." Ye Lin turned around, looked at Xia Wanqing who was still on the ground and kicked her calf."Are you full?" Xia Wanqing wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes, got up from the ground and patted her butt: "You're full, you're full. This melon is so filling, it's even bigger than a dumpling." "When you're full, work." Ye Lin took out the half bottle of [Morning Rose Essential Oil] from his pocket and put it on the coffee table.The liquid inside the glass bottle is as viscous as honey, and fine golden light can be vaguely seen flowing.A strange rose fragrance instantly filled the narrow rental house.Just after taking a sip, Xia Wanqing felt that all the fatigue in her body had dissipated."What is this?" Xia Wanqing came over curiously and reached out to take it."Don't move." Ye Lin slapped her paw away."This is a good thing, a good thing that can make you stronger." Since we want to train this girl to be a thug...oh no, partner.Then you have to start investing now.After all, the days to come will not be peaceful.In the early stage of the revival of mythology, ordinary people were like ants.Although Ye Lin has a system, he still needs a trustworthy helper.The main thing is that he doesn't want to be a dog to God.This bottle of essential oil was given by Aphrodite. Although there was only half a bottle left, it was something for the gods.It should... be useful, right?"So what are you going to do?" Xia Wanqing asked doubtfully.Ye Lin glanced at her plain chest: "Take off your clothes."
